brief:
Israeli settlers demolished homes in a Jericho village, leaving Palestinian families displaced and homelessness spreading across the community, Al Jazeera English reported. The demolitions reduced multiple residences to rubble, destroying family shelters and personal possessions in the process.

The destruction prompted accusations that the Israeli government bears direct complicity in the settler actions. Palestinian families displaced by the demolitions now face uncertain housing prospects and mounting humanitarian concerns.

Settler operations have escalated across Palestinian territories in recent periods, with residential structures in contested regions serving as frequent targets for demolition. The incident underscores deepening tensions between settler expansion and Palestinian presence in the West Bank.
dek: Israeli settlers demolish homes in village, leaving rubble and fear among displaced Palestinian families in Jericho.
title: Israeli settlers demolish Palestinian homes in Jericho village
